purpose: Dedicated Dragon Rush Z login title screen
prompt:
Create a polished illustrated background for the LOGIN TITLE SCREEN of the fan-made Dragon Ball browser RPG Dragon Rush Z. One brand new full-bleed landscape wallpaper, widescreen 16:9 at high resolution. Hand-painted 1980s original Dragon Ball anime opening aesthetic, crisp ink outlines, sophisticated cel shading, expressive authentic Toriyama proportions, rich turquoise sea, warm ivory clouds, sunny golden orange accents. NOT a dashboard, NOT a UI mockup, NOT modern adult Super Saiyan portraits, NOT photorealism, NOT 3D, NOT childish preschool mascot illustration.
Composition explicitly for responsive UI overlays: the LEFT 62 percent contains the complete artwork focal subject; the RIGHT 38 percent is mostly calm pale blue sky and a soft cloud bank, with sea toward bottom, offering clean unobtrusive space for an HTML login form. In the LEFT half, centered around x=30 percent, y=55 percent, original young Son Goku (black spiky hair, red-orange sleeveless gi with navy belt and wristbands, monkey tail) joyfully and confidently rides his yellow Kinto-Un / Flying Nimbus cloud above the sea, facing slightly toward viewer/right. Goku's whole body, both hands, both bare forearms, both boots, tail, and entire compact Nimbus cloud must be complete and readable, not cropped by frame. He is seated astride the cloud in a physically coherent easygoing pose, one hand resting on knee and other lightly holding a red Nyoi-Bo power pole laid securely across his lap; five fingers per hand, natural elbows, unambiguous footwear orientation, no double limbs. The cloud supports his body. Big enough to be an instantly recognizable hero, yet leave the top 25 percent of the LEFT half calm sky for a logo placed in code. Focal subject confined between x=10 to 49 percent, y=32 to 78 percent. No object in front of his face. Small classic pink Kame House with a red roof on a palm-lined island in the far lower-left background, turquoise clear ocean, cream surf, tiny tropical rocky islands on horizon, soft rounded anime clouds, light sunrise haze. A sense of breezy adventure and nostalgic Dragon Ball. The horizon is around y=72 percent. Broad sunlit sky with subtle warm light, uncluttered silhouette, carefully balanced negative space. No text at all anywhere, no KAME HOUSE lettering (roof blank), no logos, watermarks, letters, numbers, stars embedded into sky, spheres, cards, interface frames, UI buttons, HUD, menus, other characters, floating fragments, extra poles, duplicated anatomy, or malformed architecture. Produce only the illustration, fully opaque background.
